metadata.domain: Bangladesh Agriculture & Disaster Management - Official Institutional Protocols

documents.title: DAE Extension Standard Operating Procedures
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL DAE EXTENSION SOP (Department of Agricultural Extension, MoA)
## 1. Rapid Field Triage & Damage Assessment
- SAAOs (Sub-Assistant Agriculture Officers) must conduct field inspections within 24 hours of hazard alert. Quantify crop submergence depth and lodging percentage.
- Emergency Drainage: Mobilize community labor (Shramik groups) to clear field drainage channels and sluice outlets immediately.
- Fertilizer Adjustment: Halt top-dressing of nitrogenous fertilizers during heavy rainfall or impending floods to prevent soft vegetative growth. Apply Muriate of Potash (MoP) post-event to enhance stalk rigidity.
- Early Harvest Trigger: If standing Aman or Boro rice is at dough/mature stage (80% grain maturity) and severe weather/cyclone/flood is forecast within 72 hours, advise immediate harvesting even with high grain moisture (use tarpaulins for sun-drying).

documents.title: BRRI Stress-Tolerant Rice Variety Protocols
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL BRRI VARIETY CATALOG & AGRONOMIC PROTOCOLS (Bangladesh Rice Research Institute)
## 1. Submergence Tolerance (Flash Floods / Haor Basin)
- **BRRI dhan51 & BRRI dhan52**: Tolerate complete submergence under clear or moving water for up to 10-14 days during vegetative stages.
## 2. Salinity Tolerance (Coastal Belt: Satkhira, Khulna, Bagerhat, Cox's Bazar)
- **BRRI dhan47**: Tolerates seedling stage salinity up to 12 dS/m; ideal for Boro season in coastal polders.
- **BRRI dhan53, BRRI dhan54, BRRI dhan73, BRRI dhan89, BRRI dhan92**: Provide high yield under moderate coastal soil salinity (6-8 dS/m) during Aman season.
## 3. Drought & Heat Resilience (Barind Tract & High Barind)
- **BRRI dhan56, BRRI dhan65, BRRI dhan82**: Deep root system and osmotic adjustment mechanisms for dry spell survival.
## 4. Water Saving Management
- **AWD (Alternate Wetting and Drying)**: Use perforated PVC observation tubes; irrigate only when water table drops 15 cm below soil surface, saving 30% irrigation water without yield penalty.

documents.title: BARI Non-Rice Crop Protocols
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL BARI CROP PROTOCOLS (Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute)
## 1. Wheat & Maize Climate Stress Management
- **Wheat (BARI Gom-33)**: Heat-tolerant variety resistant to terminal heat stress during grain filling stage in Rabi.
- **Maize (BARI Hybrid Maize-11 & 14)**: High lodging resistance against pre-monsoon Nor'westers (Kalbaishakhi).
## 2. Potato & Winter Vegetables
- **Late Blight Mitigation (Phytophthora infestans)**: When relative humidity > 85% and temperature ranges 12-20°C, apply Mancozeb 80 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Metalaxyl + Mancozeb at 7-day intervals.
- **Cold Wave Protection**: Erect polythene sheet tunnels over nursery seedbeds and vegetable plots during night minimum temperatures < 10°C.

documents.title: BADC Emergency Seed & Input Distribution Protocols
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL BADC PROTOCOLS (Bangladesh Agricultural Development Corporation)
## 1. Certified Seed Buffer Stocks
- Maintain regional buffer stocks of short-duration, high-yielding seeds (BRRI dhan56, Moong pulse, and Maize) in district warehouses for rapid post-disaster replanting.
- Coordinate with DAE dealer networks to distribute subsidized certified seeds within 5 days of disaster declaration.
## 2. Deep & Shallow Tube-Well (DTW/STW) Operation
- Ensure uninterrupted electricity or subsidized diesel supply for irrigation pumps during prolonged dry spells or pre-monsoon drought alerts.

documents.title: BLRI Livestock Feed & Housing Protocols
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL BLRI PROTOCOLS (Bangladesh Livestock Research Institute)
## 1. Fodder Conservation During Floods
- **Urea-Molasses Straw (UMS) Blocks**: Distribute compressed UMS blocks to maintain ruminant nutrition when green fodder is submerged.
- **Silage Making**: Produce maize silage in airtight plastic drums during surplus seasons for rainy season stockpiling.
## 2. Heat Stress Mitigation in Poultry & Cattle
- Provide electrolyte supplements (potassium chloride, sodium bicarbonate, Vitamin C) in drinking water during ambient temperatures > 35°C.
- Install roof sprinklers and wet jute sack curtains on poultry shed wire mesh to lower ambient temperature by 4-6°C.

documents.title: DLS Veterinary Emergency & Vaccination SOPs
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL DLS DISASTER SOP (Department of Livestock Services)
## 1. Emergency Evacuation
- Evacuate livestock from low-lying chars and flood plains to designated government 'Killas' (raised earthen mounds) and elevated community sheds ('Machrang').
## 2. Post-Disaster Ring Vaccination
- Within 7 days of flood recession, execute mass ring vaccination campaigns for:
  - **Anthrax**: Spore vaccine for cattle and goats in endemic districts (Sirajganj, Pabna, Manikganj).
  - **FMD (Foot and Mouth Disease)**: Biennial vaccination.
  - **PPR (Peste des Petits Ruminants)**: Essential for goats before monsoon and winter.
- **Hoof Care**: Treat foot rot with 5% copper sulphate foot baths.

documents.title: DOF & BFRI Fisheries & Aquaculture Disaster Protocols
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL DOF & BFRI PROTOCOLS (Department of Fisheries & Fisheries Research Institute)
## 1. Haor Basin & Inland Open Waters
- **Pre-Flood Harvest**: Execute emergency partial harvesting of table-size carps (Rui, Katla, Mrigal) when flash flood alert is issued.
- **Cage Culture**: Secure floating net cages in Meghna and Surma-Kushiyara rivers with heavy concrete anchors and double-tied mooring lines.
## 2. Coastal Shrimp Ghers & Polders
- **Pre-Cyclonic Surcharge**: Lower gher water depth by 20% to prevent dike overtopping. Install fine-mesh nylon screen nets ('Mahajal') across sluice gates to prevent escape of cultured Penaeus monodon (Bagda) and Macrobrachium rosenbergii (Golda).
- **Soil Salinity Management**: Apply agricultural gypsum (2 t/ha) and flush ponds with freshwater before restocking.
- **Post-Flood Rehabilitation**: Apply Agricultural Lime (CaCO3) at 250 kg/ha to neutralize acidic soils and clear water turbidity.

documents.title: WHO, UNICEF, & DPHE WASH Protocols
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL WHO, UNICEF & DPHE WASH PROTOCOLS (Water, Sanitation, Hygiene)
## 1. Safe Drinking Water Interventions
- **Tube-Well Sanitization**: Shock-chlorinate submerged tube-wells using a 1% chlorine solution (bleaching powder) immediately after floodwaters recede. Pump out contaminated water for 15 minutes before consumption.
- **Purification Tablets**: Distribute Aquatabs (Sodium Dichloroisocyanurate) or Halazone tablets (1 tablet per 10 liters of clear water; 2 tablets for turbid water, 30 minutes contact time).
## 2. Diarrhea & Disease Prevention
- **ORS & Zinc**: Stockpile Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) and Zinc sulfate dispersible tablets at all Union Health and Family Welfare Centers to treat acute watery diarrhea (cholera risk).
- **Sanitation**: Construct raised emergency slab latrines above highest flood level to prevent fecal-oral contamination of water bodies.

documents.title: Comprehensive Bangladesh Agro-Ecological Calendar
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL BANGLADESH AGRO-ECOLOGICAL SEASONAL CALENDAR (BARC / DAE)
## 1. Kharif-I (Mid-February to Mid-June - Pre-Monsoon)
- **Crops**: Aus rice, Jute, Maize, Summer Vegetables.
- **Hazards**: Nor'westers (Kalbaishakhi windstorms), pre-monsoon flash floods (Haor basin), heatwaves.
- **Advisory Focus**: Early harvesting of spring crops, reinforcing jute retting basins, windbreaks for orchards.
## 2. Kharif-II (Mid-June to Mid-October - Monsoon)
- **Crops**: Transplanted Aman rice, Broadcast Aman.
- **Hazards**: Heavy monsoon downpours, riverine floods, tropical cyclones, tidal surges in coastal belt.
- **Advisory Focus**: Transplanting with submergence-tolerant varieties, maintaining field bund height, polder gate management.
## 3. Rabi (Mid-October to Mid-February - Winter)
- **Crops**: Boro rice, Wheat, Potato, Mustard, Lentil, Winter vegetables.
- **Hazards**: Cold waves, dense fog, frost, late blight in potato.
- **Advisory Focus**: Boro seedbed polythene covering, irrigation management (AWD), fungicide spraying for potato blight.

documents.title: FAO & World Bank Anticipatory Action Frameworks
documents.content:
# OFFICIAL FAO & WORLD BANK ANTICIPATORY ACTION PROTOCOLS
## 1. Forecast-Based Financing (FbF)
- When HazardNet forecast confidence > 85% and lead-time is 72 hours for high-severity floods or cyclones, trigger pre-disaster cash transfers and input packages.
## 2. Agricultural Crop Insurance
- Facilitate digital crop insurance claims verification via SAAO telemetry data and satellite SAR backscatter flood mapping for rapid payout to smallholder farmers through mobile financial services (bKash/Nagad).
